daily.today_energy: Mars conjunct Jupiter is amplifying your natural fire—you're feeling bold and ready to move on big ideas. Just watch that Sun-Mars square; it's asking you to channel that energy thoughtfully instead of bulldozing through.
daily.love: Venus sextile Jupiter is bringing warmth to your connections. If you've been holding back, today's vibe supports honest conversations. Single? Your confidence is magnetic right now, but avoid coming on too strong.
daily.career: That Sun-Jupiter square is creating tension between your vision and reality—which is actually useful. You can see what needs adjusting on a project. Mars energy supports taking action, but slow down enough to get buy-in first.
daily.health: Your body's craving movement with all this Mars-Jupiter fire, but the Sun square aspect suggests not overdoing it. Balance intensity with rest. Hydrate well and listen to what your energy is actually telling you.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is all about authenticity, Sag. Venus is whispering you deserve better boundaries and Mercury's vibes suggest clarity is coming. Trust the little nudges pointing you toward what actually matters.
weekly.love: If you're coupled up, this is peak time for real talk that feels good. Single? Someone's noticing your glow. Either way, stop dimming yourself down—your weird is exactly what someone needs right now.
weekly.career: Projects you've been sitting on are ready to move. Your natural confidence is magnetic this week, so lean into collaboration over solo grinding. The universe is basically handing you permission to level up.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for presence, not perfection. Whether that's stretching, dancing, or just sleeping without your phone—listen to what actually feels nourishing instead of what sounds productive.
